Card Q&A.a: 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign], other than [Sea Animal], in any of its traits or 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with the [TS] trait.
Card Q&A.q: What cards can be played by this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign], other than [Sea Animal], in any of its traits or the [TS] trait from your trash without paying the cost.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
